_status: Brazilian broker demo for WIN/WDO, confirmed 2026-11-16 by a read-only probe (account_info, symbols, history counts; no prices looked at, no orders). Plan item 1 of research/reviews/2026-11-14-veredito-1m-5m.md is met.
_credentials: The login is kept by the terminal itself (it stays logged in). Never write the password in the repository; never use a server whose name has PRD or REAL.
attach: MetaTrader5.initialize(path=terminal_path) attaches to the running, logged-in terminal; refuse to continue unless account_info().trade_mode == ACCOUNT_TRADE_MODE_DEMO

symbols._continuous: $N = by liquidity, no adjustment (WIN$N tick 5 pts, BRL 1.00/tick; WDO$N tick 0.5 pts, BRL 5.00/tick); $ = proportional adjustment; @ = by expiry. Continuous series are data only (trade_mode 0).

history_measured_2026_11_16._note: One request returns at most 50,000 bars (terminal 'Max bars in chart' = 100,000): export by date windows. Real (exchange) volume is present on every bar.
